description: Mass-formula assembly chain for the neutron at 50 dps.  Parallel to the proton chain (`build_proton_mass_50dps_chain.py`, PR #480 + PR #476).  Anchored in the fully-trusted Markov-trace assembly chain (PR #612) and the Phase A 50 dps Terms 2–6 (PR #476).  Trust profile {axiom: 0, derived: 2, script-cited: 3, computational: 1} — the SCRIPT_CITED frontier still covers the T1+T2+T3+T4 mass-endomorphism tower assembly.  Current neutron mass prediction: 0.561168 MeV vs CODATA 939.56542052 (rel_diff 0.9994, 9.994e+8 ppb).  Target: 1 ppb.

steps.name: tr_M(n, q_0) at 50 dps via Markov-trace assembly chain
steps.operation: Reference `markov-trace-assembly-neutron.derivation.json` (fully-trusted on main as of PR #612).  The 50 dps evaluation comes from `atomic_tr_m_mpfr_50dps.py`'s Wenzl-bridge pipeline (mpmath at 50 dps); cross-checked against the polynomial-ring path at machine precision via `markov_pipeline_cross_validator`.
steps.notes: Derivation chain: markov-trace-assembly-neutron.derivation.json (fully-trusted after PR #612 added the `atomic-braid-recipe-n` chain; profile {axiom: 1, derived: 7, computational: 1}, no SCRIPT_CITED frontier).  Numerical eval at 50 dps via Wenzl-bridge (atomic_tr_m_mpfr_50dps.py).

steps.name: Mass-formula Terms 2–6 at 50 dps (Phase A precision lift)
steps.operation: Reference `mass-formula-6term-mpfr-50dps.witness.json` (produced by `mass_formula_6term_mpfr_50dps.py` from PR #476's Phase A precision lift).  All six unified-mass-formula terms evaluated at 50 dps mpmath: Term 1 (descended trace), Term 2/3 (Φ_q tower via mp_Phi_q), Term 4 (Frobenius co-Casimir), Term 5 (chirality BW), Term 6 (Habiro residue tail).
steps.notes: script: folio-assistant/computations/mass_formula_6term_mpfr_50dps.py.  SCRIPT_CITED — the per-term assembly into a single mass-cat-units value awaits its own derivation chain (open frontier: terms 2-6 individually need per-term chains analogous to the σ_shell A=2 closed form for Term 7).

steps.name: m_n_Hecke (neutron mass in cat units, 50 dps)
steps.operation: Sum the T1+T4 trustable-subset of the mass-endomorphism tower for the neutron at 50 dps, via the substrate-only Path A derivation (`derive_m_n_hecke_path_a.py`).  T2/T3/T5/T6 quarantined per the trustable-subset analysis: T2/T3 structurally empty at A=1 under the current level-selection rule, T5 sign-indefinite, T6 small Habiro tail.  SCRIPT_CITED (per-term assembly chains still open).
steps.notes: script: folio-assistant/computations/derive_m_n_hecke_path_a.py (neutron-side counterpart of derive_m_p_hecke_path_a.py).  SCRIPT_CITED — the T1+T2+T3+T4 assembly itself awaits its own derivation chain; the current value is T1+T4 only (trustable subset).  Phase A item (50 dps lift) on PR #476 brings each term individually to mpmath precision.  **Precision note**: the stored `output_value` is a 50-significant-figure decimal string from `mp.nstr(..., 50)` (50-dps full precision lives in the upstream `mass-formula-6term-mpfr-50dps.witness.json`; consumers needing more than 20 sig figs should read that witness directly rather than this chain step).  **Alternative-paths cross-reference**: the PR #564 ρ_K^LO path consumes CODATA $m_p$ and $m_n$ to produce 0 ppb residuals for $\{p, n\}$ by construction; that path violates the three-calibration discipline (audit doc: docs/audits/2026-05-11-three-calibration-discipline-violations.md). This chain follows the discipline strictly — substrate-only T1+T4, no $m_n$ injection — so the residual is the honest open-R&D delta, not a calibration tautology.

steps.name: m_e_Hecke (electron mass in cat units, 50 dps)
steps.operation: Same tower formula applied to the electron's 2-strand atomic braid; 50 dps via the same mpmath pipeline.
steps.notes: script: folio-assistant/computations/derive_m_e_hecke_path_a.py (electron Path A; consumed via M_HECKE_PIPELINE_AT_Q0['e']).  SCRIPT_CITED until the electron-tr-M-q0 chain ships.  **Precision note**: the stored `output_value` is a 50-significant-figure decimal string from `mp.nstr(..., 50)` (full 50-dps precision lives in the upstream `mass-formula-6term-mpfr-50dps.witness.json`).

steps.name: Dimensionless mass ratio m_n/m_e at 50 dps
steps.operation: Compute the ratio m_n_Hecke / m_e_Hecke at 50 dps.  The framework predicts this ratio dimensionlessly; CODATA fixes the absolute scale via m_e.
steps.notes: Pure arithmetic (ratio of two 50 dps values).

steps.name: Scale by CODATA m_e (MeV) → m_n in MeV
steps.operation: m_n (MeV) := (m_n_Hecke / m_e_Hecke) × M_E_MEV.  M_E_MEV = 0.51099895 MeV is the **single CODATA-bounded constant** the framework consumes.
steps.notes: COMPUTATIONAL leaf: m_n_pred ≈ 0.561168 MeV vs CODATA m_n = 939.56542052 MeV.  Current relative error: 0.9994 = 9.994e+8 ppb (target: 1 ppb).  Closing the gap requires Phase A item completion (Terms 2-6 at full 50 dps without f64 chokepoints), rebasing onto the ρ_K canonical path (0 ppb empirically via atomic_mass_via_rho_k.py), and Phase B (q_0 derivation to clear the 780 ppb CAL-2 floor).
